audience: breweries and distilleries that run orders, stock and purchasing in BrewMan

useCases.title: See open orders for delivery
useCases.text: List orders for a date range, with a result limit, then open one to read its lines.

useCases.title: Check stock levels by location
useCases.text: Read the stock on hand per item and location, with the known incoming and outgoing totals.

useCases.title: Look up outlets and their price lists
useCases.text: Open an outlet to read its contact, address and credit terms. List the price lists to use when you create an order.

useCases.title: Track purchase orders still awaiting delivery
useCases.text: List purchase orders by status, supplier and date to see what is still due.

useCases.title: Create an order and add its lines
useCases.text: Create an open order for an outlet, then add stock item lines to it.

useCases.title: Cancel an order with a reason
useCases.text: Cancel an order and record the reason. A cancelled order cannot be reopened through the API.
